lessons: Confirmed-correct-do-not-relitigate (2026, verified against official btl.gov.il rate pages): child allowance first/fifth-plus at the base rate and second-to-fourth at the higher rate; child-savings monthly deposit with optional parent match and the age-21 bonus; daycare-subsidy minimum-income thresholds for couples and single parents; credit-point monthly value (frozen through 2027); maternity/birth grant still varying by birth order. A web search may surface an erroneous higher child-allowance figure (a stray snippet quoted inflated per-child amounts); the official BTL rate page is authoritative and matches the skill, do not 'correct' the skill to the stray snippet.

Fixed this cycle: disabled-child allowance low band updated to the current year and reframed (base levels span a wide range up to the highest severity level; the ventilator-dependent figure is a supplement ON TOP of the base, not a standalone total). The prior text understated the top of the range and mislabeled the ventilator figure.
Fixed this cycle: the special-education committee English transliteration was corrected to reflect 'characterization' (ipyun/אפיון), not 'review' (iyun). The Hebrew name was already correct.

Lesson: when correcting a benefit amount, grep every file for the BENEFIT (not just the old number). The disabled-child allowance appeared in the special-education reference file under a DIFFERENT, looser range that a value-grep on the old number missed; the panel caught the leftover contradiction. Search by topic, not only by the figure you are replacing.

Grounding note: the special-ed support-hour bands are illustrative (the committee sets the basket per child) and are now labeled as such; the objection-window day-count was reworded to point at the decision notice rather than assert an unverified number. If a future cycle can source the exact statutory objection window and per-severity hour entitlements, back them and restore the specifics.
